title: Language version recap, style, and performance — quick overview
rememberThis: This module maps C# 8–14 onto modules 01–17; it is not where you first learn nullable, records, or Span.
net10.0 means C# 14. Do not set LangVersion to latest. Raising language above TFM is unsupported.
Records are a language feature for value-shaped data; they are not automatically your domain model.
Interview review order: correctness and lifetime, then allocations, then public surface, then naming.
bullets: Nullable reference types are module 07; do not re-explain them here — cite them.
field-backed properties, extension members, and implicit span conversions are C# 14.
PascalCase public members, _camelCase private fields, I-prefix interfaces — compiler does not enforce this.
DTO for Redis/SQS JSON; domain type for invariants; record when equality and with-expressions are the point.
